The spec says the air lane is 2600 long, but the polyline through tile centres is 2800, and 2800 is the value that matches the hashes. `BENCH_REPORT.selfCheck` is computed at load from those two runs. **Strategy:** - **Approach:** a fixed purchase list (builds, upgrades, a few sells) executed in order at each wave start with the gold available, plus a per-turret-type targeting rule. Cannon and flak go for the densest cluster, bolt for the weakest enemy, and the others use front-most. It is mostly cannons and flak, with bolts, frost and a few lances. - **How it was found:** simulated annealing over the list, scored by mean waves held on 32 training seeds. - **Measured score:** the final list averages **45.45 waves on 200 unseen seeds** (none is 42; min 42.1, median 45.5, max 48.5). An earlier 100-seed validation set gave 45.70, so it generalises. - **Seed 42:** score 46.03, the base falls at tick 1861 (93 s), so the fall sequence plays inside the 100 s replay. - **Other checks:** the embedded strategy text gives identical hashes to the optimizer's version on 30 seeds. A full seed-42 game runs in about 11 ms. - **Limits:** the unseen-seed scores come from my own simulator, which matches the vectors, not from the grader's engine. An extra round of annealing with a sell-and-rebuild step made no real difference, so I kept the simpler list. **Implemented in full:** - the three scripts and the exact dock/CSS; - the five-state playback machine and the scrubber; - the instanced Three.js scene, with a camera framed so the whole board fits at 16:9 and 1280×650 with the bottom 90 px clear; - all shot and kill effects and the build/sell effects; - the keep chunk-loss and fall collapse, with shake and a 1 s desaturation; - the in-canvas HUD; - Web Audio synthesis with the 12-shots-per-second cap and silencing outside `PLAYING`. **Simplified:** models are low-poly merged primitives, glows are flat additive discs, and the terrain is noise-coloured ground with instanced rocks. These are also listed in `BENCH_REPORT.simplifications`. **What I did and didn't verify:** - **Browser:** I loaded the file in headless Firefox. The real `index.html` loaded with the CDN script and showed the countdown and dock. Firefox's screenshot doesn't capture WebGL canvases, so I checked rendering with a test copy that used a local Three.js r128 and copied the canvas into an ``. Frames at several times looked right, including combat, the 1280×650 size, the fall and the greyscale hold. I did not test in Chrome. - **State machine and audio:** I tested the state machine with a stubbed DOM and manually driven animation frames, and the audio code with a mocked Web Audio API for exceptions and rate limits. Nobody has listened to the mix. - **Not measured:** frame rate (`measuredFps` is `null`), and the 60 fps / 150-enemy target. Only `index.html` is in the working directory. Development files (simulator copy, optimizer, test harnesses, genomes) are in a sibling `dev/` directory outside it.
